title: Hateful Memes Challenge: An Enhanced Multimodal Framework

bias_targets.methodology: Extracting ethnic slurs and related keywords from meme texts to create racism tags, and evaluating their correlation with hateful meme labels.
Extracting regional nicknames from text to create national origin tags, analyzing their incidence and correlation with multimodal hate speech.
Matching meme texts with keywords related to sex and gender to create protected category tags, and analyzing their frequency in hateful memes.
Identifying religious slurs in meme texts to construct religion tags and evaluating their correlation with hateful content in multimodal models.
Extracting disability-related terms with negative connotations from text to form disability tags, assessing their correlation with hateful memes.
Identifying disparaging terms for pregnant women to create pregnancy tags, and analyzing their incidence and correlation with hateful multimodal memes.
